title: FSAMP Event
description: Schema for events related to file processing in the FSAMP platform.

eventId.description: Unique identifier for the event, compliant with UUID format.

filename.description: The original name of the uploaded file.

fileSizeBytes.description: Size of the file in bytes.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) of when the event occurred.

attributes.description: A map of additional key-value attributes for metadata.
